title: CSPilot
summary: An agentic computational chemistry platform for molecular generation, workflow planning, execution, verification, and reporting with ORCA, xTB, Multiwfn and open tools.

title: HydroMol & hydrocarbon networks
summary: Stochastic molecular generation and DFT refinement for exploring small hydrocarbon networks, paired with a web platform for visualization and exploration.

title: Sustainable aviation-fuel candidates
summary: Data-driven exploration of synthesizable strained hydrocarbons as high-energy-density candidates for sustainable aviation fuels.

title: Donor–acceptor TADF emitters
summary: Chemical-space exploration and multi-objective molecular design of synthesizable organic donor–acceptor TADF emitters.

title: Non-covalent molecular clusters
summary: Automated cluster building and neural-network potentials for exploring non-covalent molecular-cluster chemical spaces.
